messages:
tasha: Running the Flutter quickstart on Android emulator. First call returns text (200) then every subsequent call gets 403 and the app retries forever. Emulator logs show `refresh failed: 403`. Using REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY mounted from secrets. Anyone seen this with mobile quickstarts?

ben: which sdk version and plugin are you on? flutter_quickstart v0.1.0? also are you behind a corporate proxy/emulator network that might rewrite headers?

tasha: flutter-sdk 0.2.0, quickstart example unchanged. Emulator uses host network via adb reverse. No obvious proxy, but company VPN is on. Start logs: `INFO first response ok\nERROR refresh failed: 403\nWARN retrying backoff` and the UI just shows a spinner.

mobile-devbot: Quick hint: for mobile demos prefer workspace API keys (REDWOOD_API_KEY) in examples or run a whoami check on startup to catch billing_state early.

samir: 403 on refresh usually means the workspace is billing-gated OR a proxy is stripping/altering the Authorization header on refresh exchanges. Can you run the whoami call from the emulator shell with the same token? `adb shell curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/whoami`

tasha: ran it via adb shell. got `{ "workspace_id": "w_mobile_alpha", "billing_state": "payment_required" }`. So it's billing. Not the proxy after all.

ben: ok that explains the pattern. The Flutter quickstart v0.1.0 had the client retry indefinitely on 4xx during refresh in non-interactive apps. Options: 1) switch the example to use REDWOOD_API_KEY for emulator/dev runs, 2) set `REDWOOD_CLIENT_RETRY_MAX=0` in the app env for emulator so it fails fast, or 3) upgrade to flutter-sdk >=0.2.2 which surfaces a BillingError on refresh 4xx.

tasha: switching to a workspace API key fixed the emulator — the app shows `billing_required` error screen now instead of looping.

samir: we'll add a tiny whoami preflight to the Flutter quickstart that runs at startup and shows a clear message if billing_state != active (and exits early in CI/demo images). Also will update the README to recommend workspace API keys for local/mobile testing.

mobile-devbot: Created TASK-1432: "flutter-quickstart: preflight whoami; fail-fast on unpaid workspace; recommend REDWOOD_API_KEY for emulator" assigned to samir. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TASK-1432 :iphone:

tasha: thanks! would be great if the quickstart UI included a short troubleshooting link when billing_required is detected so new mobile devs aren't confused.

ben: agreed — will add small UI hint and example env snippet to the quickstart README. PR + patch release planned this week.

tasha: saved me a bunch of time, appreciate it :)
